titles: Every Giant Wave Ever Measured, Shown to Scale
The Wave That Climbed Higher Than the Empire State Building
In 2025, a 481-Metre Wave Hit a Fjord Cruise Ships Visit Every Day
hook: In August 2025 a mountainside fell into Tracy Arm, Alaska, and the water climbed 481 metres up the opposite slope: higher than the Empire State Building. It is only the second tallest wave ever measured. We line up every giant wave on record, Taan Fiord, Greenland, Vajont, Spirit Lake, Tracy Arm and the 1958 Lituya Bay record, next to the Statue of Liberty, the Eiffel Tower and the Empire State Building, using real USGS and NASA photos of the places they hit.
